homePage.weDesignSpacesSubtitle: Based in Luxembourg, our design studio brings together architecture, design and craftsmanship to create interiors that are both functional and timeless.
homePage.weDesignSpacesDescription: From custom-made furniture and tailor-designed kitchens to kids’ rooms, bathrooms, dressing areas and smart storage solutions, we bring creative ideas to life with precision and care. We also design and install wood floors, interior doors and carry out complete renovations from start to finish. Our work spans private residences as well as business projects, always tailored to the needs and lifestyle of our clients.

aboutPage.aboutDescription: We, led by Andre Lopeseco, create bespoke interior design, carpentry, and custom furniture solutions. We blend craftsmanship and functionality to elevate both residential and commercial spaces, transforming visions into timeless, personalized environments.
aboutPage.aboutCompany: Through teamwork and shared vision, Lopeseco Design Studio elevates every project into something truly exceptional.
aboutPage.conceptPlanningDescription:
Turning your ideas into bespoke furniture concepts, carefully tailored to your
space and style.
aboutPage.homeMakeoverDescription: Full-scale home transformations that refresh, modernize, and elevate your space.
aboutPage.qualifiedCarpentersDescription: Skilled craftsmen delivering precise, high-quality carpentry for every project.
aboutPage.3DRendersDescription: Bringing designs to life with realistic and detailed 3D visualizations.
aboutPage.premiumFurnitureDescription: Featuring exclusive collections from kave home, Lightinova, Caressi, Miele, Gaggenau, Rotpunkt, among many other high-end brands.
aboutPage.deadlineCommitmentDescription: Delivering projects on time and within budget while maintaining exceptional quality.

teamPage.teamDescription: Passionate individuals combining creativity, craftsmanship, and expertise on every project. Their commitment ensures seamless coordination, thoughtful design, and exceptional execution, making each space we transform both beautiful and practical.
teamPage.quoteTitle: Design is not just what it looks like and feels like. Design is how it works.
teamPage.quoteParagraph: At Lopeseco Design Studio, I believe that true design goes </br>beyond aesthetics. It’s about creating spaces that function seamlessly, serve their purpose, and enrich everyday life. Every project we undertake reflects this philosophy, blending beauty with practicality.
